id_policy.trial_id: Assigned once per physical release; site/local date plus T sequence. Never renumber existing IDs when earlier records are found.

id_policy.unassigned_site_prefix: UNK is a provisional ID prefix only; site_alias stays empty. Bench/Edith/unlabelled support calibrations are not relabelled as study sites.
id_policy.dataset_id: Reuse a historical inventory ID only after timestamp and both EC channels match row by row. Otherwise assign DS plus the first 16 hex digits of the original electronic source SHA-256; preserve this registry on later renames.
id_policy.step_no: Original point_order minus one; gaps preserve omitted source rows.
